{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.24

|gr1= Inventory

|descr=Add virtual magazines to an object (e.g., ammo box). Virtual items can be selected in the [[Arsenal]].

|s1= [object,magClasses,addItemsGlobal,arsenal] call [[BIS_fnc_addVirtualMagazineCargo]]

|p1=object: [[Object]] - object to which items will be added

|p2=magClasses: [[Boolean]], [[String]] or [[Array]] of [[String]]s - magazine classes

|p3=addItemsGlobal: [[Boolean]] - (Optional, default [[false]]) [[true]] to add items globally

|p4=arsenal: [[Boolean]] - (Optional, default [[true]]) [[true]] to add [[Arsenal]] action

|r1= [[Array]] of [[String]]s - all virtual magazines

|x1= <sqf>[BIS_ammoBox, ["class_1","class_2"], false, true] call BIS_fnc_addVirtualMagazineCargo;</sqf>

|seealso= [[Arsenal]] [[BIS_fnc_addVirtualBackpackCargo]] [[BIS_fnc_addVirtualItemCargo]] [[BIS_fnc_addVirtualWeaponCargo]] [[BIS_fnc_arsenal]] [[BIS_fnc_getVirtualBackpackCargo]] [[BIS_fnc_getVirtualItemCargo]] [[BIS_fnc_getVirtualMagazineCargo]] [[BIS_fnc_getVirtualWeaponCargo]] [[BIS_fnc_removeVirtualBackpackCargo]] [[BIS_fnc_removeVirtualItemCargo]] [[BIS_fnc_removeVirtualMagazineCargo]] [[BIS_fnc_removeVirtualWeaponCargo]]
}}
